title: Annotatio II §.VI: Letter to Berengar — altar bread/wine UNIATUR to the virgin-born body
pass_a_gloss: His words are these: Nor truly ought we to marvel or distrust that God can make this which is consecrated on the Altar (namely bread and wine), by the virtue of the Holy Spirit and the ministry of the priest, be UNITED to that body which our Redeemer assumed from the Virgin Mary — both a corporeal substance, both visible.
pass_b_english: His words: do not marvel that God can make altar-consecrated bread and wine, by Spirit and priest, be united to the body our Redeemer took from Mary.
Both are corporeal substance; both visible.
source_text: Verba ejus hæc sunt: Neque vero mirari vel diffidere debemus, Deum facere posse ut hoc quod in Altari consecratur (nempe panis & vinum) virtute Spiritus Sancti & ministerio sacerdotis, UNIATUR corpori illi, quod ex Maria Virgine Redemtor noster assumsit, utrumque substantia corporea, utrumque visibile.

rejected: be united as a trade union
